notes: Satuq Bughra Khan was an early ruler of the Qarakhanid Khanate and is traditionally regarded as the first major Turkic ruler to embrace Islam. His conversion became a key landmark in the Islamization of Central Asia.
Nefertiti was the Great Royal Wife of Akhenaten during Egypt's Eighteenth Dynasty and played a prominent ceremonial and religious role in the Amarna period.
Modu Chanyu unified the Xiongnu under his rule around 209 BCE, created a powerful steppe empire, and established Xiongnu dominance across much of the eastern Eurasian steppe.
